title: Community Counseling
intro: We provide non-medical counseling services and help service members and their families develop skills to manage life's stressors and challenges.​

sections.heading: Eligibility & How To Get Started
sections.markdown:
#### Getting Started

Offering support to service members and their families within the military community.

#### Getting Started

Eligibility for participation in our Community Counseling Program extends to individuals across various segments of the military community. This includes:

*   Active-Duty Service Members - All Branches
*   Civilian Expeditionary Forces
*   Spouses
*   Families
*   Children
*   Recruits

**How to get started with Community Counseling:**

1.  **Schedule an Appointment:** Contact the Community Counseling Program office and speak to a professional about scheduling an appointment with a mental health clinician.
2.  **Assessment:** A Community Counseling Program clinician will conduct an intake assessment which typically involves a structured evaluation designed to identify an individual's needs, concerns, and goals regarding their mental health and well-being.
3.  **Counseling Services:** Following your initial assessment, you and the clinician will identify appropriate services.
4.  **Case Management Services:** If individuals or families are working with multiple providers and managing multiple systems, our staff and clinicians are available to assist you.
5.  **Referral Services:** Our staff will help you to identify other services to meet your specific needs for those beyond what is offered at the Community Counseling Program.

#### Counseling, Services, and Support

The Community Counseling Program utilizes a holistic approach to support individuals, children, couples, and families. Our clinicians provide solutions designed to meet your specific needs in the following areas:

*   Relationship Concerns
*   Work Stressors
*   Life Stressors
*   EAS/PCS and Challenges Related to Transition
*   Grief and Loss
*   Sadness
*   Worry
*   Deployment Cycle Stressors and Reintegration
*   Adjustment
*   Crisis Intervention
*   Sleep Hygiene
*   Parent-Child Communication

Establish a connection with professionals at Community Counseling and discover a successful journey toward overcoming life's challenges.

sections.heading: Programs, Services & Support
sections.markdown:
#### Semper Support

Free virtual, confidential counseling for Marines and families.

[Learn more](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/benefits/marine-corps-semper-support/)

#### Domestic Abuse

Information and resources that provide support to you and your family.

[Learn more](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/domestic-abuse)

#### Sexual Assault Prevention and Response

Resources and support for the prevention and response to sexual assault.

[Learn more](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/sexual-assault-prevention-and-response)

#### Substance Misuse

Support for alcohol and illicit drug misuse through education and training.

[Learn more](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/substance-misuse)

#### Suicide Prevention

Valuable suicide prevention resources and support that is within reach.

[Learn more](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/suicide-prevention)

#### Military and Family Life Counselors

Free, confidential counseling for service members, their families and survivors.

[Learn more](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/benefits/military-family-life-counseling-program/)

#### 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline

Counselors are here for you 24/7, providing free and confidential support for life's challenges.

[Learn more](https://988lifeline.org/)
